## Machine release

Machine/family, version, author, and a short description of the sound:

## Contribution

- [ ] One-machine `.syx` or `.mds` release added under `mds/`.
- [ ] Entry added or updated in `mds/catalog.json`, with the exact file SHA-256.
- [ ] Author, summary, license, source/project links and compatibility notes are accurate.
- [ ] Redistribution rights and required license notices are included.
- [ ] Package ID/version/controls are correct; updates retain the stable machine ID.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes and the deployment preview shows the expected metadata.

## Validation

Declared clocks/block, measurement method and timing evidence:

Simulator and hardware testing performed (state clearly if hardware is untested):

Memory, firmware dependencies and changes affecting existing kits:

Source/build instructions or pinned source link:

See [the contributor guide](https://github.com/etcetc000/kitbasher/blob/main/mds/README.md#submit-a-community-machine). Approval, merge and successful deployment publish the catalog entry automatically.
